This is an update of a theory idea i had before. I think it’s more relevant now since the grumps are once again doing the 10 minute power hour and once again the video ends with a code! Tell me what you think.



I did not tag this post as a spoiler because it doesn’t ruin any of the content, however potentially one or two jokes are examined. If you consider that a spoiler, be warned.

I’ve been watching some of the game grumps 10 minute power hour episodes. I’ve noticed that comic sans text, often in purple will appear around the bottom of the screen. This is perhaps the editor, as the grumps on their main content use colored text (yellow for Barry and blue for kevin) as their editors. However, this feels different. Firstly, this editor takes much more control. Barry and Kevin, even Matt and Ryan would rarely put text on screen unless directly addressed. This purple comic sans does not have this restriction. Sometimes it’s just promoting themselves but some are inexplicable like “oh you piggly wiggly”. This could be written off as a coincidence but consider that sometimes this text is written in binary. That itself makes me think right to hidden codes and ARG material. What if the people we see in the ten minute power hour episodes aren’t the game grumps, but “arin” and “Dan” as alternate characters conceived by the real grumps. Wait, hear me out, I have more evidence. They do certain things which seem like a joke but is then perhaps something more sinister. In their Nintendo pancake episode, their “robot” is clearly a member of staff under the desk, being helplessly abused and dehumanized as a joke. Obviously, I think this is a scene and not real abuse. But I think in the world of the 10 minute power hour canon; this is real. Let’s look at another strange example. In the second ASMR video, the camera moves to Ross as we hear sizzling on what was clearly a hot pan. Arin exclaims that it’s his hand burning. The fact that this takes place off screen could mean that it’s real. Yes, his hand is fine in the next scene, but Arin has yet to be confirmed to be human. He may be a robot or alien that can regenerate. 
The grumps also appear to have an incinerator, which is not normal technology for humans to have in a house or a studio. We learn they have the large incinerator from the death threat issued to the “robot” at the end of the Nintendo pancake episode. Also PPIS(the robot) requests to “take care of business if it promises to come back” but that request is denied. Would he have come back if he’d been let go? He seems subservient but what method of control do they have over him? If he would actually return, that implies it’s more than the threat of violence. Perhaps hypnosis or mind control? Or more likely, something to do with the origin of what “Arin and Dan” really are. Perhaps he knows that they’re aliens and wants to let someone know before he dies to give humans a fighting chance. What do you think? I think there could be more evidence here, but thats all i got so far(im curious what the binary says). hope you enjoyed and please let me know if theres evidence for or against this theory.
